srList.sentence: In the follow-up evaluation, the shoulder function was assessed by an independent specialist using the Constant-Murley Score (CMS) at least nine months after operation.[19] Further outcome measure included Disabilities of the Arm, Shoulder and Hand (DASH) score.[20] The 12-item Short Form-12 (SF-12) was used to evaluate the patient-reported impact of health on an individual's everyday life.[21] Statistical analysis Statistical analysis was performed using the IBM SPSS version 25.0 software (IBM Corp., Armonk, NY, USA).
